name: yaml-field
title: YAML Field
description: YAML editor that flags values that load without error but change meaning (NO/yes/on/off as booleans, 1.10 as 1.1, 0755 as octal, 22:22 as base-60), duplicate keys, tabs and misaligned indentation, with line, column, the parsed value and one-tap fixes.

meta.summary: Catches YAML that parses but means something else, like NO read as false or 1.10 read as 1.1, and shows what the parser will read.
catches: Plain scalars YAML 1.1 loaders turn into booleans (NO, yes, on, off)
Duplicate keys, with the first occurrence
limits: Targets YAML 1.1 behaviour (PyYAML, Psych, SnakeYAML, go-yaml v2); YAML 1.2 loaders differ
Not a full YAML parser; complex documents can produce misses
a11y: Visible <label>; status via aria-describedby in a polite live region
Each issue has a button labelled with its line and column
After a fix, focus returns to the textarea
